expected_vs_realized.note: expected = sum(make prob x points) over unblocked, unwhistled attempts; N=100 sims/game, so realized team-game means carry MC noise

family_response_table.note: joint OLS of team points on standardized family composites (+ home flag); real points are single-game and noisy

ranked_failure_modes.confidence: medium (83 team-seasons; correlation SE about 0.11, but both halves and the volume run agree)
ranked_failure_modes.effect_size: neutralizing all five tendencies lifts ranking correlation with real season PPG from 0.072 to 0.254 (three_point_preference alone 0.156, the other four 0.153)
ranked_failure_modes.mechanism: style tendencies act as strength levers (three_point_preference, drive_aggression, pass_vs_shoot, midrange_preference, pullup_vs_catch)
ranked_failure_modes.observed_mismatch: team 3PA-rate SD sim 0.059 vs real 0.038; sim efficiency correlation with the three_point_preference composite +0.44 vs real +0.15; drive_aggression has the opposite sign; preference sweep p10->p90 moves ORtg by about +16
ranked_failure_modes.type: modeling deficiency (dispersion set at player level, never checked at team level; the 2.0 preference weight amplifies it)

ranked_failure_modes.effect_size: neutralizing OREB + ball security + finishing role + other tendencies cuts attempt SD to 1.46 and lifts ranking correlation to 0.187; OREB + ball security alone 0.118
ranked_failure_modes.mechanism: shot-volume mechanics (offensive rebounds, ball security, finishing role) create team volume differences with no real counterpart
ranked_failure_modes.observed_mismatch: sim shooting-attempt volume SD 3.38 (real 3.41) but correlation with real -0.08; 76% of sim attempt variance tracks offensive rebounds; efficiency itself correlates +0.34
ranked_failure_modes.type: modeling deficiency (no team pace/style signal; offensive rebounds convert to extra attempts almost one-for-one)

ranked_failure_modes.effect_size: efficiency slopes roughly half of real for initiation and passing; depth absent because only the primary five play
ranked_failure_modes.mechanism: creation, passing and depth are under-translated while finishing role is over-applied to volume
ranked_failure_modes.observed_mismatch: team-season efficiency correlation real vs sim: initiation +0.47/+0.24, passing +0.52/+0.33, finishing role +0.35/+0.06, depth +0.33/0.00; passing sweep p10->p99 moves ORtg by under 1

ranked_failure_modes.effect_size: small share of between-team variance (turnovers 0.6% of ORtg variance)
ranked_failure_modes.mechanism: free throws and turnovers: foul drawing disabled, turnover cost too weak
ranked_failure_modes.observed_mismatch: FT-rate correlation real vs sim -0.17; FT rate is 12.8% of simulated ORtg variance; sim turnovers about 19.4 per 100 possessions; 0.76 points lost per turnover

ranked_failure_modes.effect_size: information gap rather than an engine bug; cannot be repaired from current inputs
ranked_failure_modes.mechanism: real pace / team style is not in the player state
ranked_failure_modes.observed_mismatch: real team volume varies as much as the simulated volume (SD 3.41) but no player-state family predicts it (|r| <= 0.22)

recommended_intervention.action: make style tendencies redistribute attempts without acting as a strength lever: calibrate team-level shot-diet dispersion (3PA-rate SD) to real, and make the diet-to-efficiency effect come from each player's own per-shot-type skill rather than from the tendency itself; re-check the sign of drive_aggression
recommended_intervention.target: team-level shot-selection tendencies (three_point_preference plus the four style tendencies)
recommended_intervention.validation_plan: team-season 3PA-rate SD and correlation, efficiency vs 3PT-preference slope, team-season points-per-shooting-attempt ranking, then one holdout re-evaluation
recommended_intervention.why_first: largest measured single-family recovery in ranking correlation, direct dispersion mismatch (0.059 vs 0.038), and it was amplified by the recent preference-weight change

rejected_mechanisms.expected_vs_realized_randomness: sign mismatch persists using expected shot points (r 0.98 with realized)
rejected_mechanisms.player_id_or_order: identical results across hash seeds, id relabelling and lineup permutations (within Monte Carlo noise)
rejected_mechanisms.seed_path_dependence: first-quarter margin correlates 0.46-0.58 with final margin (0.5 expected from independent quarters); initiator identity explains ~0
rejected_mechanisms.team_level_shooting_conversion: 3PT/FT/midrange slope 1.06-1.14 per unit skill; efficiency corr 0.34 with matching spread
